# BEGIN ProFluencer Awards (managed by GitHub Actions deploy — do not edit inside this block)
DirectoryIndex index.html
Options -Indexes

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On

    # Pass the Bearer token through to PHP (Sanctum auth).
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:Authorization} .
    RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]

    # /api and /api/... -> Laravel. Everything else is the static React
    # build (hash routing, so no SPA fallback rewrite is needed).
    RewriteRule ^api(/.*)?$ laravel.php [L,QSA]
</IfModule>
# END ProFluencer Awards
